case_title: MAUREEN DUNNE ET AL VS. ANN HOM

docket_entries.description: ORDER ON REQUEST TO POSTPONE TRIAL **GRANTED**
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-31-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO MAY-02-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-02-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-02-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF MAUREEN DUNNE AND EMMA PERREIRA ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANN HOM IS PRESENT WITH SUPPORT BRETRICE BRZOZOWSKI, DAUGHTER AND WITNESS SIMON WONG HOANG & INVEST, PROPERTY MANAGER. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $450 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUN 2ND HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $450 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUN 2ND HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-02-2022 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO JUL-07-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 DUE TO THE UNAVAILABILITY OF A JUDICIAL OFFICER TO HEAR THIS MATTER. (D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF MAUREEN DUNNE IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EMMA PERREIRA IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANN HOM IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. PARTIES MET THE TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
